observations.mesher: Absolute linear deflection, radians angular deflection, serial meshing of deep geometry copy without cached meshes.
observations.normals: Pinned helper uses actual UV/surface normals and its native singular-node fallback; copied triangulation only.
observations.orientation: World-space location applied; reversed face reverses normals and triangle winding.
observations.payload: 48-byte position+normal vertex,16-byte zero-based triangle+mesh-local face,24-byte count/status/maximum-deflection info.
observations.limits: 1M exported vertices/2M triangles/65536 faces. No partial output writes on short buffers; every face must have actual triangulation.

scope: Native candidate tessellation, not original Rhino mesh/material/render equivalence.
